dynamic_line.gendered_line: *turns to look at you, lifting an enormous cowboy hat off his eyes.  He appears to be in the process of growing out a set of bushy muttonchops and a handlebar mustache.  Bright blue eyes peer out from his wrinkled face.  "Howdy, pardner.  They call me Clemens.  John Clemens.  I'm an ol' cowhand."

responses.text: Hi John, nice to meet you.  <end_talking_leave>
